query: SELECT vtd.type_name AS 车型, SUM(v.load_capacity) AS 总载重量 FROM transportation.vehicle v JOIN common.vehicle_type_dict vtd ON v.vehicle_type_code = vtd.type_code GROUP BY vtd.type_name
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS company_count FROM transportation.shipping_company GROUP BY status

SELECT ad.city_name AS city, COUNT(*) AS vehicle_count FROM transportation.vehicle v JOIN common.administrative_division ad ON v.area_id = ad.id WHERE ad.province_name = '江苏省' GROUP BY ad.city_name ORDER BY vehicle_count DESC
SELECT business_type, COUNT(*) AS company_count FROM energy.energy_company GROUP BY business_type ORDER BY company_count DESC
SELECT business_type, COUNT(*) AS company_count FROM transportation.shipping_company GROUP BY business_type ORDER BY company_count DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transportation.vessel WHERE max_load > 50000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS a2_driver_count FROM transportation.driver WHERE license_type = 'A2'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS vehicle_count FROM transportation.vehicle v JOIN common.administrative_division a ON v.area_id = a.id WHERE a.province_name = '辽宁省'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS vehicle_count FROM transportation.vehicle v JOIN common.administrative_division a ON v.area_id = a.id WHERE a.province_name = '江西省'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS vehicle_count FROM transportation.vehicle v JOIN common.administrative_division ad ON v.area_id = ad.id WHERE ad.province_name = '青海省'
SELECT mmsi, company_id, vessel_type, max_load, max_speed, endurance, captain_name, area_id FROM transportation.vessel WHERE max_load < 5000
SELECT mmsi, max_speed FROM transportation.vessel WHERE max_speed >= 25;
SELECT vehicle_id, plate_number, brand, model, load_capacity FROM transportation.vehicle WHERE load_capacity IS NULL
SELECT vehicle_id, plate_number, brand, model, manufacture_year, register_date FROM transportation.vehicle WHERE model = 'X5'
SELECT driver_id, name, gender, birth_date, license_type, issue_date, valid_years, phone, address, area_id, status, company_id FROM transportation.driver WHERE birth_date >= '1991-01-01'
SELECT e.employee_id, e.name, e.gender, e.company_id FROM transportation.employee e WHERE e.gender = '女'
SELECT name FROM transportation.driver WHERE license_type = 'C1'
SELECT plate_number, brand FROM transportation.vehicle
SELECT vehicle_id, plate_number, load_capacity FROM transportation.vehicle WHERE load_capacity > (SELECT AVG(load_capacity) FROM transportation.vehicle)

SELECT vc.company_name, COUNT(v.vehicle_id) AS vehicle_count FROM transportation.vehicle_company vc LEFT JOIN transportation.vehicle v ON vc.company_id = v.company_id GROUP BY vc.company_id, vc.company_name

SELECT vc.company_id, vc.company_name, SUM(v.load_capacity) AS total_load_capacity FROM transportation.vehicle_company vc LEFT JOIN transportation.vehicle v ON vc.company_id = v.company_id GROUP BY vc.company_id, vc.company_name

SELECT sc.company_id, sc.company_name, AVG(v.max_speed) AS avg_max_speed FROM transportation.shipping_company sc JOIN transportation.vessel v ON sc.company_id = v.company_id GROUP BY sc.company_id, sc.company_name

SELECT ad.province_name AS province, vtd.type_name AS vehicle_type, COUNT(*) AS vehicle_count FROM transportation.vehicle v JOIN common.administrative_division ad ON v.area_id = ad.id JOIN common.vehicle_type_dict vtd ON v.vehicle_type_code = vtd.type_code GROUP BY ad.province_name, vtd.type_name ORDER BY ad.province_name, vtd.type_name

SELECT v.brand AS 品牌, ad.province_name AS 省份, COUNT(*) AS 车辆数量 FROM transportation.vehicle v JOIN common.administrative_division ad ON ad.id = v.area_id AND ad.level = 1 GROUP BY v.brand, ad.province_name ORDER BY v.brand, 车辆数量 DESC

SELECT AVG(v.load_capacity) AS avg_load_capacity FROM transportation.vehicle v JOIN common.vehicle_type_dict t ON v.vehicle_type_code = t.type_code JOIN common.administrative_division d ON v.area_id = d.id WHERE t.type_name = '货车' AND d.city_name = '南京市'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transportation.vehicle v JOIN common.vehicle_type_dict t ON v.vehicle_type_code = t.type_code WHERE v.area_id LIKE '2301%' AND t.type_name = '货车' AND v.load_capacity > 15;
SELECT mmsi FROM transportation.vessel WHERE vessel_type = 35

SELECT v.vehicle_id, v.plate_number, v.owner_id, v.vehicle_type_code, v.brand, v.model, v.manufacture_year, v.load_capacity, v.seat_count, v.color, v.register_date, v.area_id, v.insurance_expire, v.company_id FROM transportation.vehicle v JOIN common.administrative_division ad ON v.area_id = ad.id WHERE ad.province_name IN ('上海市','江苏省','浙江省','安徽省')
SELECT vehicle_id, plate_number, brand, load_capacity FROM transportation.vehicle WHERE brand = '福田' AND load_capacity > 10

SELECT t.type_name, COUNT(CASE WHEN v.load_capacity <= 5 THEN 1 END) AS light, COUNT(CASE WHEN v.load_capacity > 5 AND v.load_capacity <= 15 THEN 1 END) AS medium, COUNT(CASE WHEN v.load_capacity > 15 THEN 1 END) AS heavy FROM transportation.vehicle v JOIN common.vehicle_type_dict t ON v.vehicle_type_code = t.type_code GROUP BY t.type_name;
SELECT stock_name, listing_date FROM finance_tax.stocks WHERE listing_date < '2015-01-01'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT company_id) AS company_count FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns WHERE tax_year = 2025
SELECT t.open_price, t.close_price FROM finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t JOIN finance_tax.stocks s ON t.stock_id = s.stock_id WHERE s.stock_code = '000001' AND t.trade_date = '2025-12-31'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.company_id) AS company_count FROM finance_tax.companies c JOIN finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r ON c.company_id = r.company_id WHERE r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE
SELECT s.stock_code, s.stock_name, s.current_price * s.total_shares AS total_market_value FROM finance_tax.stocks s WHERE s.market_class = 'A'

SELECT c.company_id, c.company_name, t.revenue AS total_revenue FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns t JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON c.company_id = t.company_id WHERE t.tax_year = 2025 ORDER BY t.revenue DESC

SELECT c.company_id, c.company_name, cur.revenue AS revenue_2025, prev.revenue AS revenue_2024, cur.revenue - prev.revenue AS revenue_diff FROM finance_tax.companies c JOIN finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns cur ON c.company_id = cur.company_id AND cur.tax_year = 2025 LEFT JOIN finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns prev ON c.company_id = prev.company_id AND prev.tax_year = 2024

SELECT c.company_name, t.revenue FROM finance_tax.companies c JOIN finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns t ON c.company_id = t.company_id WHERE c.registration_type_code = '117' ORDER BY t.revenue DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT i.industry_name, COUNT(*) AS private_company_count FROM finance_tax.companies c JOIN common.dict_industry i ON c.industry_code = i.industry_code WHERE c.is_private = TRUE GROUP BY i.industry_name

SELECT (cf.total_assets * 10000) / s.total_shares AS bps FROM finance_tax.companies c JOIN finance_tax.stocks s ON s.company_id = c.company_id JOIN finance_tax.company_financials cf ON cf.company_id = c.company_id WHERE c.company_name = '贵州茅台' AND cf.report_date = '2025-03-31'

SELECT s.stock_code, s.stock_name, (MAX(t.high_price) - MIN(t.low_price)) / AVG(t.close_price) AS volatility_ratio FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id WHERE t.trade_date >= '2025-01-01' AND t.trade_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY s.stock_id, s.stock_code, s.stock_name

SELECT s.stock_code, s.stock_name, s.current_price, (s.current_price / ((cf.total_assets * 10000) / s.total_shares)) AS pb FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.company_financials cf ON s.company_id = cf.company_id WHERE cf.total_assets > 0 AND s.total_shares > 0 ORDER BY pb DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT AVG(revenue - non_taxable_income - deductions - prior_year_losses) AS avg_taxable_income FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns WHERE tax_year = 2025

SELECT (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * 0.10 AS tax_saved FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.stocks s ON r.company_id = s.company_id WHERE s.stock_name = '腾讯控股' AND r.tax_year = 2024;

SELECT ((r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * CASE WHEN c.is_key_high_tech THEN 0.15 WHEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE THEN 0.20 ELSE 0.25 END / r.revenue) * 100 AS effective_tax_rate FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE c.company_name = '中国中车' AND r.tax_year = 2025;

SELECT (f.dividend_stock / 100.0) / s.current_price * 100 - 6.375 AS diff_pct FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id WHERE s.stock_name = '中国石化' AND f.report_date = '2025-12-31';

SELECT c.company_id, c.company_name, r.tax_year, r.revenue, r.non_taxable_income FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON c.company_id = r.company_id WHERE r.revenue > 0 AND r.non_taxable_income > r.revenue * 0.5

SELECT i.industry_name, CASE WHEN c.is_private = TRUE THEN '民营企业' ELSE '国企' END AS enterprise_type, AVG((r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * CASE WHEN c.is_key_high_tech THEN 0.15 WHEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE THEN 0.20 ELSE 0.25 END) AS avg_tax FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id JOIN common.dict_industry i ON c.industry_code = i.industry_code WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 GROUP BY i.industry_name, c.is_private ORDER BY i.industry_name, enterprise_type;

SELECT s.stock_code, s.stock_name, STDDEV((t.close_price - t.open_price) / t.open_price) * SQRT(250) AS annualized_volatility FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id WHERE YEAR(t.trade_date) = 2025 GROUP BY s.stock_id, s.stock_code, s.stock_name

SELECT s.stock_name, (f.dividend_stock / 100.0) / s.current_price * 100 AS dy FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON s.company_id = c.company_id JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id WHERE f.report_date = '2025-12-31' AND (f.dividend_stock / 100.0) / s.current_price * 100 > (SELECT AVG((f2.dividend_stock / 100.0) / s2.current_price * 100) FROM finance_tax.stocks s2 JOIN finance_tax.companies c2 ON s2.company_id = c2.company_id JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f2 ON s2.company_id = f2.company_id WHERE f2.report_date = '2025-12-31' AND c2.industry_code = c.industry_code);

SELECT e.education, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM energy.employee e JOIN energy.energy_company ec ON e.company_id = ec.company_id JOIN common.energy_position_dict ep ON e.position_code = ep.position_code WHERE ec.area_id LIKE '54%' AND ep.category = '管理' GROUP BY e.education ORDER BY employee_count DESC;

SELECT et.type_name AS energy_type, COUNT(*) AS station_count FROM energy.energy_station es JOIN common.energy_type_dict et ON es.energy_type_code = et.type_code WHERE es.area_id = '632801' GROUP BY et.type_name

SELECT ec.company_name, COUNT(cc.id) AS cert_count FROM energy.energy_company ec JOIN energy.company_certification cc ON ec.company_id = cc.company_id WHERE cc.cert_type = '承装修试许可证' GROUP BY ec.company_id, ec.company_name;

SELECT ep.category, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, e.hire_date, CURDATE())) AS avg_tenure FROM energy.employee e JOIN common.energy_position_dict ep ON e.position_code = ep.position_code WHERE e.hire_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ep.category;

SELECT p.position_name, COUNT(e.employee_id) AS employee_count FROM energy.employee e JOIN common.energy_position_dict p ON e.position_code = p.position_code GROUP BY p.position_name ORDER BY employee_count DESC

SELECT ad.province_name AS 省份, COUNT(*) AS 光伏电站数量 FROM energy.energy_station es JOIN common.administrative_division ad ON es.area_id = ad.id WHERE es.station_type_code = 'SP' AND ad.province_name IN ('黑龙江省','吉林省','辽宁省','北京市','天津市','河北省','山西省','内蒙古自治区','陕西省','甘肃省','青海省','宁夏回族自治区','新疆维吾尔自治区') GROUP BY ad.province_name ORDER BY 光伏电站数量 DESC
SELECT business_type, AVG(staff_count) AS avg_staff FROM energy.energy_company GROUP BY business_type;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS bachelor_above_count FROM energy.employee e JOIN energy.energy_company ec ON e.company_id = ec.company_id WHERE ec.area_id LIKE '11%' AND e.education IN ('本科','硕士','博士');
SELECT COUNT(e.employee_id) AS employee_count FROM energy.employee e JOIN energy.energy_station es ON e.station_id = es.station_id WHERE es.area_id LIKE '3203%' AND es.energy_type_code = 'THERMAL';
SELECT COUNT(e.employee_id) AS employee_count FROM energy.employee e JOIN energy.energy_station es ON e.station_id = es.station_id WHERE es.area_id LIKE '1507%' AND es.energy_type_code = 'THERMAL';
SELECT COUNT(e.employee_id) AS employee_count FROM energy.employee e JOIN energy.energy_station es ON e.station_id = es.station_id WHERE es.area_id LIKE '3408%' AND es.energy_type_code = 'THERMAL';
SELECT COUNT(e.employee_id) AS employee_count FROM energy.employee e JOIN energy.energy_station es ON e.station_id = es.station_id WHERE es.area_id LIKE '5133%' AND es.energy_type_code = 'HYDRO';

SELECT SUM(es.installed_capacity) AS total_capacity FROM energy.energy_station es JOIN common.administrative_division ad ON es.area_id = ad.id WHERE ad.name = '格尔木市' AND es.station_type_code = 'SP'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS hydro_station_count FROM energy.energy_station es JOIN common.administrative_division ad ON es.area_id = ad.id WHERE ad.city_name = '吉林市' AND es.station_type_code = 'HP'
SELECT SUM(annual_supply) AS total_supply FROM energy.supply_area WHERE area_id LIKE '3703%';
SELECT COUNT(*) AS wind_farm_count FROM energy.energy_station es JOIN common.administrative_division ad ON es.area_id = ad.id WHERE ad.city_name = '天水市' AND es.station_type_code = 'WP'

SELECT SUM(es.annual_generation) AS total_annual_generation FROM energy.energy_station es JOIN common.administrative_division ad ON es.area_id = ad.id JOIN common.station_type_dict std ON es.station_type_code = std.type_code WHERE ad.city_name = '赤峰市' AND std.type_name = '风电场'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS gas_station_count FROM energy.energy_station es JOIN common.administrative_division ad ON es.area_id = ad.id WHERE ad.city_name = '绵阳市' AND es.energy_type_code = 'GAS'
SELECT SUM(annual_generation) AS hydro_generation FROM energy.energy_station WHERE area_id LIKE '5132%' AND energy_type_code = 'HYDRO';

SELECT SUM(es.annual_generation) AS total_annual_generation FROM energy.energy_station es JOIN common.administrative_division ad ON es.area_id = ad.id WHERE ad.city_name = '中卫市' AND es.station_type_code = 'SP'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT es.company_id) AS company_count FROM energy.energy_station es JOIN common.administrative_division ad ON es.area_id = ad.id WHERE ad.city_name = '青岛市' AND es.station_type_code = 'WP';

SELECT es.station_name, es.installed_capacity FROM energy.energy_station es JOIN common.administrative_division ad ON es.area_id = ad.id WHERE ad.province_name = '湖北省' AND es.energy_type_code = 'HYDRO'
SELECT es.station_name, es.installed_capacity FROM energy.energy_station es JOIN common.administrative_division ad ON es.area_id = ad.id WHERE ad.city_name = '中卫市' AND es.energy_type_code = 'WIND'

SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, ROUND(SUM(o.payable_amount), 2) AS total_amount FROM ecommerce.customer c JOIN ecommerce.orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT inventory_id, product_id, warehouse_code, warehouse_name, stock_quantity, locked_quantity, safety_stock, updated_time FROM ecommerce.inventory WHERE stock_quantity < 10

WITH _edu_semester_rows AS (
SELECT r.semester_id, r.academic_year, r.semester_code, r.start_date_key, r.end_date_key, 2025 AS _source_year FROM education_2025.semester r 
UNION ALL
SELECT r.semester_id, r.academic_year, r.semester_code, r.start_date_key, r.end_date_key, 2024 AS _source_year FROM education_2024.semester r 
),
_edu_semester_ranked AS (SELECT r.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(r.academic_year, ''), CONCAT('__unmapped:',r._source_year,':',r.semester_id)), COALESCE(NULLIF(r.semester_code, ''), CONCAT('__unmapped:',r._source_year,':',r.semester_id)) ORDER BY r._source_year DESC, r.semester_id DESC) AS _merge_rank FROM _edu_semester_rows r),
edu_semester AS (SELECT r.semester_id, r.academic_year, r.semester_code, r.start_date_key, r.end_date_key, r._source_year FROM _edu_semester_ranked r  WHERE r._merge_rank=1)
SELECT semester_code, start_date_key, end_date_key FROM edu_semester ORDER BY academic_year ASC LIMIT 10

WITH _edu_department_rows AS (
SELECT r.department_id, r.department_code, r.department_name, 2025 AS _source_year FROM education_2025.department r 
UNION ALL
SELECT r.department_id, r.department_code, r.department_name, 2024 AS _source_year FROM education_2024.department r 
),
_edu_department_ranked AS (SELECT r.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(r.department_code, ''), CONCAT('__unmapped:',r._source_year,':',r.department_id)) ORDER BY r._source_year DESC, r.department_id DESC) AS _merge_rank FROM _edu_department_rows r),
edu_department AS (SELECT r.department_id, r.department_code, r.department_name, r._source_year FROM _edu_department_ranked r  WHERE r._merge_rank=1),
_edu_teacher_rows AS (
SELECT r.teacher_id, r.teacher_no, r.teacher_name, r.department_id, r.gender_code, r.phone, r.region_id, 2025 AS _source_year, p_department.department_code AS _department_code FROM education_2025.teacher r LEFT JOIN education_2025.department p_department ON p_department.department_id=r.department_id
UNION ALL
SELECT r.teacher_id, r.teacher_no, r.teacher_name, r.department_id, r.gender_code, r.phone, r.region_id, 2024 AS _source_year, p_department.department_code AS _department_code FROM education_2024.teacher r LEFT JOIN education_2024.department p_department ON p_department.department_id=r.department_id
),
_edu_teacher_ranked AS (SELECT r.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(r.teacher_no, ''), CONCAT('__unmapped:',r._source_year,':',r.teacher_id)) ORDER BY r._source_year DESC, r.teacher_id DESC) AS _merge_rank FROM _edu_teacher_rows r),
edu_teacher AS (SELECT r.teacher_id, r.teacher_no, r.teacher_name, COALESCE(m_department.department_id,r.department_id) AS department_id, r.gender_code, r.phone, r.region_id, r._source_year, r._department_code FROM _edu_teacher_ranked r LEFT JOIN edu_department m_department ON m_department.department_code=r._department_code WHERE r._merge_rank=1),
_edu_course_rows AS (
SELECT r.course_id, r.course_code, r.course_name, r.department_id, r.teacher_id, r.credit, r.course_type, r.max_score, 2025 AS _source_year, p_department.department_code AS _department_code, p_teacher.teacher_no AS _teacher_no FROM education_2025.course r LEFT JOIN education_2025.department p_department ON p_department.department_id=r.department_id LEFT JOIN education_2025.teacher p_teacher ON p_teacher.teacher_id=r.teacher_id
UNION ALL
SELECT r.course_id, r.course_code, r.course_name, r.department_id, r.teacher_id, r.credit, r.course_type, r.max_score, 2024 AS _source_year, p_department.department_code AS _department_code, p_teacher.teacher_no AS _teacher_no FROM education_2024.course r LEFT JOIN education_2024.department p_department ON p_department.department_id=r.department_id LEFT JOIN education_2024.teacher p_teacher ON p_teacher.teacher_id=r.teacher_id
),
_edu_course_ranked AS (SELECT r.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(r.course_code, ''), CONCAT('__unmapped:',r._source_year,':',r.course_id)) ORDER BY r._source_year DESC, r.course_id DESC) AS _merge_rank FROM _edu_course_rows r),
edu_course AS (SELECT r.course_id, r.course_code, r.course_name, COALESCE(m_department.department_id,r.department_id) AS department_id, COALESCE(m_teacher.teacher_id,r.teacher_id) AS teacher_id, r.credit, r.course_type, r.max_score, r._source_year, r._department_code, r._teacher_no FROM _edu_course_ranked r LEFT JOIN edu_department m_department ON m_department.department_code=r._department_code LEFT JOIN edu_teacher m_teacher ON m_teacher.teacher_no=r._teacher_no WHERE r._merge_rank=1)
SELECT course_id, course_name FROM edu_course WHERE course_type = '选修' ORDER BY course_name ASC LIMIT 30

WITH _edu_semester_rows AS (
SELECT r.semester_id, r.academic_year, r.semester_code, r.start_date_key, r.end_date_key, 2025 AS _source_year FROM education_2025.semester r 
UNION ALL
SELECT r.semester_id, r.academic_year, r.semester_code, r.start_date_key, r.end_date_key, 2024 AS _source_year FROM education_2024.semester r
